notes.title: Looking for Beta Testers
notes.content:
Hello, friend!

First of all, thanks for stopping by. If you're reading this, then you must be at least somewhat interested in this new little drop of water from the vast ocean of indie games called Supposedly Wonderful Future. Therefore, you're just the right person to ask for help in my quest for a stable and bug-free release. I'll try to keep this short and simple, so let's get straight to the main points.

UPDATE: as of February 2nd, I think I have all the info I needed. Many thanks to everyone who participated!

How to participate

Send me your contact details through this form. Alternatively, you can just leave a comment down below. All I need is some way to send you a private message.

What you get

A beta key that will add Supposedly Wonderful Future to your library, no questions asked. The game is complete and was already subjected to limited but fairly thorough testing, so if all goes well you'll have a release-like experience - except right now and for free.

What I'd appreciate in return

- Play the game from start to finish.
- Send me your feedback by filling out this survey.

Additional notes

The game is Windows-only at the moment, but a Mac version might happen and a Linux version will most likely happen, so if you'd like to try those, please indicate below, and I'll contact you once I have anything new. The same goes for Russian version, though I'll also try to make a proper announcement in Russian once it's done.

Low system specs shouldn't be a problem (on the contrary, it will help to double-check minimum requirements), so don't hesitate to sign up even if you play on a potato.

Thanks again for your support, and please stay tuned for future updates!
